description: Looks up one city in Audiala's audio-guide catalog and returns a city card: a short summary, the number of audio guides, up to 8 places that have a guide, and links to the city on audiala.com and in the Audiala app. Use this when the user asks what Audiala covers in a named city, or which places there have an audio guide. Do not use it for hotels, restaurants, transport, tickets or opening hours: the catalog has none of these. The catalog covers 1,900+ cities; a city that is not in it returns kind "not_found". Read-only.

lang.description: Language of the summary and links. Defaults to en.

name.description: City name. Accents and minor misspellings are tolerated, for example 'Tokyo', 'Tōkyō' or '東京'.

name: get_city_overview

app_url.description: Opens the city in the signed-in Audiala web app.

guides_count.description: Number of audio guides in the city.

listen_in_app.description: Deep link to the full guide in the Audiala app.

message.description: Why nothing matched and what to try instead.

top_places.description: Places in the city that have an audio guide, in the order of the audiala.com city page.

url.description: Public audiala.com page for the place.

title: Get city overview
